description: Gap 2 non-regression (issue #452). A sibling directory whose name shares a character prefix must stay disjoint: scripts/dev_toolsX/a.py is not inside scripts/dev_tools. This pins the anchoring of the listed-directory rule on a trailing separator, without which the widened relation would make unrelated work items contend. Both radii declare empty modules so the coarse module map cannot mask the path level.
